news.title: Meta will record employees’ keystrokes and use it to train its AI models
news.description: Meta says that it has a new internal tool that is converting mouse movements and button clicks into data that can train its AI models.

news.title: Unauthorized group has gained access to Anthropic’s exclusive cyber tool Mythos, report claims
news.description: Anthropic told TechCrunch it is investigating the claims, but maintains that there is no evidence that its systems have been impacted.

news.title: AI research lab NeoCognition lands $40M seed to build agents that learn like humans
news.description: Founded by an OSU researcher, the startup is developing AI agents that can become experts in any domain.

news.title: UK gaming icon Peter Molyneux on AI, his final creation and a changing industry
news.description: The creator of iconic series such as Fable says Masters of Albion will be the last game he makes.

news.title: Meta to track workers' clicks and keystrokes to train AI
news.description: The firm will take data from the way employees work for its artificial intelligence models.

news.title: AI hacking tools like Mythos can be 'net positive' says top cyber official
news.description: The head of the National Cyber Security Centre says frontier AI tools can be a force for good - if kept out of the wrong hands.

news.title: The Pope’s Warnings About AI Were AI-Generated, a Detection Tool Claims
news.description: Pangram Labs’ updated Chrome extension puts warning labels on AI slop as you scroll your social feeds.

news.title: OpenAI Beefs Up ChatGPT’s Image Generation Model
news.description: The ChatGPT Images 2.0 model is here. Our testing shows it’s better at creating more detailed images and rendering text, but it still struggles with languages other than English.
